_doc: THE balance knobs (owned by the bot sim, tools/sim.mjs from M12). The bestiary's formulas (monsters.json baseline) and the item ladders (item-bases.json) were designed separately; these multipliers reconcile them without editing either file. monster.hp/damage multiply every monster; `early` eases the first levels: below `untilLevel`, monster hp and damage are multiplied by `from` rising linearly to 1. hero.offHandDamage: the share of its damage a weapon in the off hand swings for (dual-wield, Doubled Grasp; js/sim/fight.js).

groups._doc: The early-game ramp (owner 2026-11-13: more 1v1 fights early, swarms and group fights a few levels later). Read by js/sim/spawn.js, keyed by the spawn MARKER's level. maxSize: the most monsters that stand together at that level (a level not listed = the table's full roll). soloChance: the chance a rolled group at that level is cut to one monster (pinned `pack` arrays keep their size, up to maxSize). swarmMinLevel: a swarm marker below this level spawns only maxSize of its swarm. championSoloUntil: a champion stands alone up to this level. strays: what the cap trims off is NOT lost — each trimmed monster becomes a separate single placed `spread` m from its marker, at least `gap` m from other strays and other markers, so a zone keeps its monster count and XP.
